text:
sam: FYI eu-north-1 GPU pool is failing ~15% of boots after yesterday's NAT keepalive reduction + new privatelink policy.
tina: Same. Keystore decrypt times out then KMS returns AccessDenied in some cases.
omar: Logs: `keystore: decrypt timeout -> error AccessDenied (missing EncryptionContext)` during bootstrap.
infra-bot: alert: gpu-pool-eu-north-1 underprovisioned (target 120 -> ready 98).
compliance: I pushed the tighter endpoint policy to limit dev access; didn't expect bootstrap to rely on EncryptionContext.
sam: Impact: autoscaler compensating by spinning nodes in eu-west -> cross-region prewarm + egress. Cost estimate ~2k/hr if not fixed. @finance FYI.
finance: noted, will watch.
tina: Quick plan: 1) revert NAT keepalive change (restore 350s) 2) if still failing, temporarily relax endpoint policy for bootstrap role 3) schedule bootstrap agent fix to include EncryptionContext.
omar: I can flip NAT in 5m and run 50 canary boots: `curl -X POST https://orchestrator/simulate-boot -d '{"region":"eu-north-1","count":50}'`
compliance: prefer NAT revert first, lower blast radius. If revert doesn't fully resolve, I'll add a short-lived explicit Allow for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/edge-bootstrap`.
infra-bot: NAT rollback scheduled for eu-north-1 in 6 minutes. Will post status.
sam: Thanks. Keep thread updated. If cost spikes beyond $3k/hr we escalate to exec oncall. :thumbsup:
